action.content: Write a funny poem for kids about a product that you would like to sell. The poem should have exactly 6 stanzas. Separated the stanzas using 3 asterisk markers: ***
action.label: context

action.content:
I'd love to sell you a gadget that's super cool,
With a screen that's bright and shiny and new.
It can do all sorts of things that you can't believe,
From drawing pictures to playing games with me.
It's like a magic wand that's in your hand,
That can make your day a whole lot more fun.

It can play music that's so sweet and soft,
That you'll want to dance and sing along.
It can tell you jokes that are so funny,
That you'll laugh out loud and say "Wow!"
It's like having a best friend by your side,
That's always there to make your day shine.

But the best part about this gadget is,
It can help you learn new things too.
It can teach you math and science,
And help you get ready for school.
It's like a tutor that's always there,
To help you succeed and be a star.

So if you're looking for a toy that's smart,
And can do all sorts of things that you can't imagine,
This gadget is just what you need,
To make your day a whole lot more fun.
It's the best toy you'll ever buy,
And I'm sure you'll love it to your heart's delight.
action.label: response
